definitions.gloss: facial features; looks (as a sign of character)
definitions.explanation: A person's face and features, especially as they seem to reveal character or fortune. Common in descriptions of suspects and in fortune-telling.

examples.japanese: {人相|にんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人相|にんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I described the culprit's appearance to the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧せい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{人相|にんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Perhaps because of years of hardship, his face has changed completely.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人相|にんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: sinister-looking, shady-looking
- {人相|にんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: one's face changes (from stress, illness, age)
- {人相書|にんそうが}き: a written description or sketch of a wanted person (old-fashioned; today ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧)
- {人相|にんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to read someone's face (physiognomy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}つき→顔つき：19660_kaotsuki⟧: the look on a face at a given moment (a serious look, a tired look)
- ⟦{容貌|ようぼう}→容貌：18942_youbou⟧: looks, features (formal, neutral about character)
- {人相|にんそう} carries the idea that the face shows what kind of person someone is, so it is often used negatively.
